blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At the executive level, the planning forum is where the company aligns its commercial ambition with operational reality. The leadership team reviews the consolidated plan, challenges the assumptions and makes the trade-off decisions that shape the quarter ahead.

At Czarnikow, this means the CEO, CFO and the heads of trading, operations and supply chain sit together around one set of numbers. They discuss volume commitments, margin targets, freight capacity and capital allocation. Every decision is recorded, and every action has an owner and a deadline.

The discipline of this process is what separates companies that react from companies that lead. When the plan is honest and the leadership is genuinely aligned, the organisation moves faster and with far less friction.

items.q: According to the text, what is the executive planning forum for?
options: Aligning commercial ambition with operational reality
items.why: "the planning forum is where the company aligns its commercial ambition with operational reality."

items.q: At Czarnikow, what do the CEO, CFO and functional heads work from?
items.why: "sit together around one set of numbers" — um número compartilhado, base de toda a discussão.

items.q: The passage states that every action coming out of the forum has…
options: a report and a follow-up email
a budget and a risk score
items.why: "every action has an owner and a deadline."

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: Honest planning reduces friction across the organisation.
Aligned leadership lets a company move faster.
Recording decisions with clear owners strengthens execution.
A well-run planning forum is mainly a chance to share updates.
items.why: Inferência: o texto contrapõe empresas que 'lideram' às que apenas reagem; o fórum é para decidir, não para repassar informação.

items.q: The phrase "companies that react from companies that lead" suggests that…
options: leadership and reaction are essentially the same discipline
most companies cannot avoid reacting to the market
reacting quickly is the mark of a strong company
planning discipline is what turns a reactive firm into a leading one
items.why: Inferência: 'The discipline of this process is what separates' — a disciplina do S&OP é o divisor entre reagir e liderar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicar como está reformulando a reunião executiva de S&OP. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Let me be blunt about the meeting we had last month. The CEO left with three more questions than she came in with, and that is a failure of the forum, not of the numbers. So I am redesigning how this runs.

From now on, it is essential that every business unit submits its inputs at least three days in advance. We reconcile them into one shared number before anyone walks into the room. If your figures are not in by the deadline, your item does not make the agenda — no exceptions, and no sending a proxy to explain later.

Inside the room, we do not review what everyone already knows. It is critical that we spend the hour on exceptions and trade-offs — where trading and operations disagree, where the cash impact is uncomfortable, where freight capacity forces a real choice. Routine updates go in the pack, not on the table.

And every senior leader attends in person. It is imperative that you engage rather than delegate to a deputy who cannot commit the function. The output is three clear decisions the CEO can own. Done well, this is a quiet advantage most of our competitors simply do not have.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why does James call last month's meeting a failure?
options: The CEO left with more questions than she arrived with
items.why: "The CEO left with three more questions than she came in with, and that is a failure of the forum."

items.q: What is the new rule about business-unit inputs?
options: They must be presented live in the room
They only matter for trading and operations
They must be submitted at least three days in advance
They can be sent by a deputy after the meeting
items.why: "it is essential that every business unit submits its inputs at least three days in advance."

items.q: How does James want the hour inside the room spent?
options: Reviewing routine updates everyone already knows
items.why: "It is critical that we spend the hour on exceptions and trade-offs."

items.q: What does James imply by refusing to accept a proxy who 'cannot commit the function'?
options: Only the CEO is allowed to make commitments
The meeting should be smaller to save time
Decisions require someone with the authority to bind their area
Deputies are less intelligent than their principals
items.why: Inferência: um representante sem poder de decidir trava o fórum; ele quer quem possa comprometer a função ali mesmo.

items.q: By calling the redesigned forum a 'quiet advantage', James suggests that…
options: competitors already run the same process
the meeting should be shorter and less formal
the process should be kept confidential from staff
the benefit is unglamorous but real and rare among rivals
items.why: Inferência: 'quiet advantage most of our competitors simply do not have' — vantagem discreta, difícil de copiar, que poucos têm.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Finance and trading finally worked from a reconciled plan." Reconciled means…
options: brought into agreement so the figures match
items.why: Reconciled = reconciliado: os números foram conciliados para baterem entre si.

items.q: Choose the correct term: "Before any debate, we agree on a single ___ so nobody argues about whose spreadsheet is right."
items.why: Shared number = número compartilhado, a base única da discussão.

items.q: "We rejected the volume increase once we saw its cash impact." This refers to…
options: the reaction of the sales team
the effect on the company's cash position
items.why: Cash impact = impacto no caixa: quanto a decisão afeta o dinheiro disponível.

items.q: "He sent a proxy who could not approve anything." A proxy is…
options: a stand-in acting on someone's behalf
items.why: Proxy = representante que age em nome de outra pessoa — aqui, sem poder de decisão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Spotting the freight shortfall ___ let us re-route cargo before it became a crisis."
items.why: In advance = com antecedência: identificar o problema antes de ele estourar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões executivas de planejamento. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The CFO still has to sign off on the capital allocation." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We agreed the plan, but nobody followed through on the freight commitments." They…
options: failed to carry it to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim aquilo que foi combinado.

items.q: "Trading pushed back on the margin target as unrealistic." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, contestar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "Reordering the agenda alone will not move the needle on decision quality." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.

items.q: "Let's iron out the freight assumptions before the CEO joins." To iron out means to…
options: resolve the small disagreements and inconsistencies
items.why: Iron out = aparar as arestas, resolver as divergências e inconsistências antes de fechar.
